versions.changelog:
video-creator 1.1.0 — Initial release

- Enables programmatic video creation using ffmpeg, Python (moviepy, Pillow), and shell scripts.
- Supports all common content types: slideshows, videos with text/subtitles, product demos, compilations/montages, and more.
- Includes platform-specific specs for YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Twitter/X, and Shorts.
- Outlines expert workflows for goal setting, asset collection, script generation, and optimization.
- Recommends when to use the remotion skill for advanced React/TypeScript-based video needs.
